detail: Added and accepted card werk-shots via CLI; typed 'Look at #wer' in the composer; Cards listbox opened with werk-shots and its title; arrows+Enter gave 'Look at #werk-shots'; menu closed; '`#wer' opened no menu.

Typed text, pasted PNG (upload held to see the spinner): '[Image #1]' at caret, spinner then thumbnail; Enter: agent turn maps [Image #1] to .werk/attachments/*.png with the 'Open each image above with Read' line; git status (all untracked) lists no attachments.
Dropped a 25 MB PNG on the composer: '[Image #1]' and chip with a '20 MB' refusal; after adding words and Enter, the turn has no [Image token or path and the attachments folder is empty.
Pasted PNG then JPEG; removed chip 1: composer reads '[Image #1]', one chip left with the .jpg thumbnail; the turn maps [Image #1] to the stored .jpg path.

Empty name, '../log.jsonl' and '../../../../etc/passwd' name requests all answered 404; after a first message (so the agent named its commands via a scripted init line), typing '/' opened the Commands menu.

Paste shows spinner chip, '[Image #1]' at caret, then thumbnail; the turn carries the stored path, the Read instruction and no image bytes. But after Enter the chat log shows the message with no image under '[Image #1]': the chat pane has no img element (client/app/chat-log.tsx has no image rendering).

Pasted 2 MB then 25 MB PNG: first chip has a thumbnail, second shows a 20 MB refusal; removing the second removes '[Image #2]' from the text; the turn lists only [Image #1] with its path; one file stored.
Pasted two PNGs, removed chip 1: text has '[Image #1]' once and no '[Image #2]', the remaining chip shows [Image #1]; the turn maps it to the second upload's stored name.
Held the upload so the spinner stayed; typed a question and pressed Enter: no message reached the agent; after the upload finished the message went out with [Image #1] mapped to the stored path.
Empty-name and climbing-name image requests answered 404; the server stayed up: a later paste showed its thumbnail and a send got a reply.
